parsed.post: Discarding the 1.0019 run. The jump is due to the removal of the leaked eval shard (shard 10). I am officially re-baselining on the clean '0-9' shards to align with the team. Starting from a clean depth-6, batch-262k, warmup-0.05, LR-0.05 config.
parsed.description: Re-baselining on clean shards 0-9 using the last known reliable hyperparameters (depth 6, batch 262k, warmup 0.05, LR 0.05, WD 0.01) to establish a valid baseline for comparison.
